UNCalendarNotificationTrigger.doc: A trigger condition that causes a notification the system delivers at a specific date and time.

UNLocationNotificationTrigger.doc: A trigger condition that causes the system to deliver a notification when the user’s device enters or exits a geographic region you specify.

UNMutableNotificationContent.doc: The editable content for a notification.

UNNotification.doc: The data for a local or remote notification the system delivers to your app.

UNNotificationAction.doc: A task your app performs in response to a notification that the system delivers.

UNNotificationActionIcon.doc: An icon associated with an action.

UNNotificationAttachment.doc: A media file associated with a notification.

UNNotificationCategory.doc: A type of notification your app supports and the custom actions that the system displays.

UNNotificationContent.doc: The uneditable content of a notification.

UNNotificationRequest.doc: A request to schedule a local notification, which includes the content of the notification and the trigger conditions for delivery.

UNNotificationResponse.doc: The user’s response to an actionable notification.

UNNotificationServiceExtension.doc: An object that modifies the content of a remote notification before it’s delivered to the user.

UNNotificationSettings.doc: The object for managing notification-related settings and the authorization status of your app.

UNNotificationSound.doc: The sound played upon delivery of a notification.

UNNotificationTrigger.doc: The common behavior for subclasses that trigger the delivery of a local or remote notification.

UNPushNotificationTrigger.doc: A trigger condition that indicates Apple Push Notification Service (APNs) has sent the notification.

UNTextInputNotificationAction.doc: An action that accepts user-typed text.

UNTextInputNotificationResponse.doc: The user’s response to an actionable notification, including any custom text that the user typed or dictated.

UNTimeIntervalNotificationTrigger.doc: A trigger condition that causes the system to deliver a notification after the amount of time you specify elapses.

UNUserNotificationCenter.doc: The central object for managing notification-related activities for your app or app extension.

UNNotificationContentProviding.doc: A protocol the system uses to provide context relevant to user notifications.

UNUserNotificationCenterDelegate.doc: An interface for processing incoming notifications and responding to notification actions.

UNAlertStyle.doc: Constants indicating the presentation styles for alerts.

UNAuthorizationOptions.doc: Options that determine the authorized features of local and remote notifications.

UNAuthorizationOptionAnnouncement.doc: The ability for Siri to automatically read out messages over AirPods.

UNAuthorizationOptionBadge.doc: The ability to update the app’s badge.

UNAuthorizationOptionCarPlay.doc: The ability to display notifications in a CarPlay environment.

UNAuthorizationOptionCriticalAlert.doc: The ability to play sounds for critical alerts.

UNAuthorizationOptionProvidesAppNotifica.doc: An option indicating the system should display a button for in-app notification settings.

UNAuthorizationOptionProvisional.doc: The ability to post noninterrupting notifications provisionally to the Notification Center.

UNAuthorizationStatus.doc: Constants indicating whether the app is allowed to schedule notifications.

UNAuthorizationStatusAuthorized.doc: The app is authorized to schedule or receive notifications.

UNAuthorizationStatusDenied.doc: The app isn’t authorized to schedule or receive notifications.

UNAuthorizationStatusEphemeral.doc: The app is authorized to schedule or receive notifications for a limited amount of time.

UNAuthorizationStatusNotDetermined.doc: The user hasn’t yet made a choice about whether the app is allowed to schedule notifications.

UNAuthorizationStatusProvisional.doc: The application is provisionally authorized to post noninterruptive user notifications.

UNNotificationActionOptions.doc: The behaviors you can apply to an action.

UNNotificationActionOptionAuthentication.doc: The action can be performed only on an unlocked device.

UNNotificationActionOptionDestructive.doc: The action performs a destructive task.

UNNotificationActionOptionForeground.doc: The action causes the app to launch in the foreground.

init(rawValue:).doc: Initializes an action options object using the specified raw value.

UNNotificationCategoryOptions.doc: Constants indicating how to handle notifications associated with this category.

UNNotificationCategoryOptionAllowAnnounc.doc: An option that grants Siri permission to read incoming messages out loud when the user has a compatible audio output device connected.

UNNotificationCategoryOptionAllowInCarPl.doc: Allow CarPlay to display notifications of this type.

UNNotificationCategoryOptionCustomDismis.doc: Send dismiss actions to the UNUserNotificationCenter object’s delegate for handling.

UNNotificationCategoryOptionHiddenPrevie.doc: Show the notification’s subtitle, even if the user has disabled notification previews for the app.
Show the notification’s title, even if the user has disabled notification previews for the app.

UNNotificationInterruptionLevel.doc: Constants that indicate the importance and delivery timing of a notification.

UNNotificationInterruptionLevelActive.doc: The system presents the notification immediately, lights up the screen, and can play a sound.

UNNotificationInterruptionLevelCritical.doc: The system presents the notification immediately, lights up the screen, and bypasses the mute switch to play a sound.

UNNotificationInterruptionLevelPassive.doc: The system adds the notification to the notification list without lighting up the screen or playing a sound.

UNNotificationInterruptionLevelTimeSensi.doc: The system presents the notification immediately, lights up the screen, can play a sound, and breaks through system notification controls.

UNNotificationPresentationOptions.doc: Constants indicating how to present a notification in a foreground app.

UNNotificationPresentationOptionAlert.doc: Display the alert using the content provided by the notification.

UNNotificationPresentationOptionBadge.doc: Apply the notification’s badge value to the app’s icon.

UNNotificationPresentationOptionBanner.doc: Present the notification as a banner.

UNNotificationPresentationOptionList.doc: Show the notification in Notification Center.

UNNotificationPresentationOptionSound.doc: Play the sound associated with the notification.

init(rawValue:).doc: Initializes a notification presentation options object using the specified raw value.

UNNotificationSetting.doc: Constants that indicate the current status of a notification setting.

UNNotificationSettingNotSupported.doc: The setting is not available to your app.

UNShowPreviewsSetting.doc: Constants indicating the style previewing a notification’s content.

UNShowPreviewsSettingAlways.doc: The notification’s content is always shown, even when the device is locked.

UNShowPreviewsSettingNever.doc: The notification’s content is never shown, even when the device is unlocked

UNShowPreviewsSettingWhenAuthenticated.doc: The notification’s content is shown only when the device is unlocked.
